description: This Java class `ShareAccountSummaryData` serves as a data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates a summary of share account information, including account identifiers, status, product details, monetary currency, and associated timeline data. It is used within the Fineract platform to represent a concise snapshot of a share account’s state and properties.

classes.name: ShareAccountSummaryData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a summarized view of a share account, including identifiers, status, currency, product details, and timeline information.

methods.name: ShareAccountSummaryData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all fields of the ShareAccountSummaryData object, applying default values for null inputs for shares counts.
